title: ShorList form
description: One form: one way in which a cryptographic algorithm appears in source code or configuration text. A row is either a positive form (the text is a use of the algorithm) or a decoy (negative: true — the text names the algorithm but is not a use of it).

id.description: Stable identifier. Never reused, never renumbered.

family.description: Algorithm family the literal names. Closed vocabulary, see schema/families.yaml.

cyclonedx_family.description: CycloneDX cryptography-defs family, only when the form pins one (e.g. SHA256withRSA -> RSASSA-PKCS1).

parameter_set.description: Parameter set, curve or key size the literal pins, or null.

role.description: Role of the algorithm as pinned by the form.

language_or_product.description: Language and library, or product, e.g. 'Python / pyca cryptography', 'Java / JCA', 'Go / stdlib', 'nginx', 'OpenSSH sshd', 'IANA TLS'.

literal.description: The exact text of the form. Must occur verbatim, on one line, in context_template.

context_filename.description: File name the template is planted under. The name is part of the context (sshd_config, nginx.conf, Main.java).

context_template.description: A minimal, syntactically valid file in which the literal stands. A decoy's template contains no positive form.

expected.description: What a scanner should report for the literal's line. For a decoy: the family a scanner would wrongly report as a use.

size.description: Key size in bits, or 'undetermined' when the form does not pin it.

negative.description: true for a decoy: text that names the algorithm but is not a use of it.

source.description: Primary sources only: the specification, registry or vendor documentation that defines the form. At least one.

status.description: verified-source: checked against the primary source. verified-run: checked by running the product or library. Unverified rows live in candidates/, not here. withdrawn: kept, never deleted.

reviewed_by.description: Reviewers. Two are required before a row is merged (enforced in review, not by the schema).
